segments.ja347:1.1: Sabbāyasaṃ kūṭamatippamāṇaṃ, paggayha yo [so (pī.)] tiṭṭhasi antalikkhe;
segments.ja347:1.3: Rakkhāya me [maṃ (sī.)] tvaṃ vihito nusajja, udāhu me cetayase [vāyamase (sī. syā.)] vadhāya.
segments.ja347:2.1: Dūto ahaṃ rājidha rakkhasānaṃ, vadhāya tuyhaṃ pahitohamasmi;
segments.ja347:2.3: Indo ca taṃ rakkhati devarājā, tenuttamaṅgaṃ na te [na hi (ka. sī. pī.), te na (ka.)] phālayāmi.
segments.ja347:3.1: Sace ca maṃ rakkhati devarājā, devānamindo maghavā sujampati;
segments.ja347:3.3: Kāmaṃ pisācā vinadantu sabbe, na santase rakkhasiyā pajāya.
segments.ja347:4.1: Kāmaṃ kandantu [kantantu (ka.), kaṇḍantu (syā.)] kumbhaṇḍā, sabbe paṃsupisācakā;
segments.ja347:4.3: Nālaṃ pisācā yuddhāya, mahatī sā vibhiṃsikāti [vibhesikāti (syā.), vihesikāti (pī.)].
